name: Cilydd

attributes.attribute: Welsh hero and father of Kulhwch
son who seeks Olwen with aid from Arthur
cousin of Cilydd and king of Camelot
sought a wife equal to his own station

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Cilydd was a Welsh hero and the son of Celyddon Wledig. As the father of the young hero Kulhwch, he urged the lad to search for his true love, the maiden Olwen. After his wife died, Cilydd looked for a new wife whose rank matched his own, and that search opens the tale Culhwch ac Olwen. The daughter of his new bride was Olwen herself, the maiden his son had to win. Cilydd sent Kulhwch to King Arthur of Camelot, his cousin, so that the young man could ask for help in winning his bride.

okr.objective: Cilydd directs his son toward the court of Arthur so Kulhwch can win Olwen.
